calendar_assumption: All listed weekdays are fictional comparable service dates, including holidays; no real Cornell or Ithaca calendar is inferred.

edge_fixtures.case: exact and near stock thresholds; empty/full

geography: Twelve anchors in Cornell core and eight surrounding anchors; official Cornell venue coordinates and TCAT GTFS20260922 transit coordinates. Geographic visual review and docking-site feasibility are separate; no existing bikeshare facilities are claimed.
limitations: No missing readings, sensor failures, closures or unusable bikes/docks in any scenario.
Inventory persists across service dates; same-hour sequences may have serial dependence, drift or boundary concentration and require independent suitability review.
No operator dispatch or nightly rebalancing is simulated; night/weekend trips and travel times are hypothetical.
Docked bikes alone need not total300 or imply50%network dock occupancy; docked plus in-transit always equals300.
Rides pending at the final21:00 observation are censored, not forced to finish; their latest arrival_due is retained in the event logs.
Normal means regular simulation, not guaranteed absence of inventory warnings or statistical signals.
Disruption is an operational redistribution, not equipment failure; detection must be evaluated independently.
No SPC implementation or baseline suitability approval is supplied by this generator.

model.capacity_handling: Empty sources skip synthetic plans; full destinations at arrival reroute to the nearest currently free permissible station with an additional positive ride duration, rechecked on arrival
model.cross_date_continuity: Individual bikes persist and rides continue across nights, weekends and service-date boundaries
model.departure_timing: Uniform integer seconds1..3599 within each absolute UTC hour; local time selects the flow profile
model.distance_pair_weight: 1 / (1 + straight-line distance in km), at most 1
model.duration_seconds: max(300, ceil(straight-line_km * 1.3 / 12km_per_hour * 3600 + uniform_integer(180,480))); explicit synthetic detour/speed/dwell assumptions, no real routes or hills
model.edge_fixtures: S20 excluded from every baseline route and reroute; first monitoring day00:00-12:00 random departures paused, prior rides must settle, then explicit positive-duration rider schedules target09/10/11fixtures; no queue clearing, teleportation or operator dispatch
model.event_ties: Arrivals and reroutes before departures; snapshot after all events at its timestamp
model.initial_allocation: 15 bikes at every station only at 07:00 on the first service date; no daily reset or operator redistribution
model.initial_bike_ids: B001-B015 at S01, B016-B030 at S02, continuing in blocks of 15 through B286-B300 at S20
model.outside_observation_window: Night/weekend rides are simulated continuously; CSV observations remain weekdays07:00-21:00
model.sensors: All automatic readings accurate, complete and on the scheduled hour
model.transfer: A departure removes one unique bike from its station into transit; only its later arrival returns it to a dock
model.weekday_07_to_10: Each interval: 16..22 residential-to-academic plans plus10background; disruption monitoring uses48..54directed instead
model.weekend_10_to_21: Each interval: 2..5outings(to17:00) or returns(after17:00) plus4background; no class surge

provenance: Inventories, bikeshare stations and flows are entirely simulated; geographic landmark anchors are real official-source coordinates. No real sensor readings, demand observations or trip records.
